Introduction

Welcome to CAT MBA Free Prep — a free, open collection of study material for the Common Admission Test (CAT), the entrance exam used by IIMs and other top B-schools in India.

This site is a work in progress. New sections covering Quantitative Ability, Verbal Ability & Reading Comprehension, and Data Interpretation & Logical Reasoning will be added over time. Check the docs section for detailed guides.
